title: Validating watch-notice renderer for native idle wake
description: Ship a small Node wrapper that turns post watch NDJSON into one bounded metadata-only notice line per batch. Grok monitor and Cursor background --once both wake on output/exit; raw watch NDJSON is not a safe injected payload (subjects/from are attacker-reachable).
design: skills/post/hooks/watch-notice.mjs. Spawn post watch with --once, --snapshot, or long-running (default). Pass through repeated --room. Validate every event with the same shapes as the lifecycle adapters. On a good non-empty batch, print exactly one line (Grok monitor treats each newline as a notification). Malformed batch: one UNKNOWN line, do not echo any event field. Scan failure: UNKNOWN on stdout, exit 1. Empty snapshot: no stdout, exit 0. No pgrep/pkill. Env POST_WATCH_NOTICE_BIN. Tests with stub post covering mail/channel/unreadable, hostile strings, over-cap, empty, failure, flag passthrough, no --room pin by default.
acceptance_criteria: node --test skills/post/hooks/watch-notice.test.mjs green. A hostile subject never appears on stdout. Grok monitor can wrap: node <copied-watch-notice> [--once|--snapshot].
close_reason: Shipped watch-notice.mjs plus watch-notice.test.mjs. One metadata-only line per batch; empty snapshot silent exit 0; scan failure UNKNOWN exit 1; Cursor/Grok installers copy it as post-watch-notice.mjs. node --test skills/post/hooks/*.test.mjs 192/192.

title: Grok Build lifecycle adapter, installer, and tests
description: Ship grok-mail.mjs + install-grok-hooks.mjs + tests. Grok 1.0.3 discovers Claude hooks but cannot run the Claude mail adapter (exec-form args dropped; SessionStart/PostToolUse stdout ignored). Register UserPromptSubmit only so we never commit seen-state for an injection the model never received. First user prompt still surfaces the launch backlog.
design: Port claude-mail.mjs. Accept hookEventName/hook_event_name and GROK_HOOK_EVENT in {UserPromptSubmit,user_prompt_submit}. sessionId or session_id. cwd or workspaceRoot (absolute). Emit Claude-style hookSpecificOutput with hookEventName UserPromptSubmit. Env POST_GROK_HOOK_*. Installer writes Grok JSON (matcher groups + type:command + single command string, not args array) to an explicit target, recommended ~/.grok/hooks/post-mail.json. Copy adapter to ~/.grok/hooks/post-grok-mail.mjs. Tests: camelCase stdin, snake_case event alias, UserPromptSubmit-only (SessionStart/PostToolUse emit {} without spawning post), port the validation/dedupe/closed-stdout matrix.
acceptance_criteria: node --test skills/post/hooks/grok-mail.test.mjs skills/post/hooks/install-grok-hooks.test.mjs green. SessionStart/PostToolUse inputs emit {} without spawning post. Installer uses a command string that includes the adapter path, never bare node.
close_reason: Shipped grok-mail.mjs, install-grok-hooks.mjs, and grok-mail/install-grok-hooks tests. UserPromptSubmit only; command string never exec-form args; dedicated ~/.grok/hooks/post-mail.json. Claude-compat is a trap (args dropped). node --test skills/post/hooks/*.test.mjs 192/192.

title: Cursor CLI lifecycle adapter, installer, and tests
description: Ship cursor-mail.mjs + install-cursor-hooks.mjs + tests. Cursor CLI (2026.08.11-e8db854) loads ~/.cursor/hooks.json, fires sessionStart/beforeSubmitPrompt/postToolUse, and injects additional_context on all three (10k char cap; public docs omit additional_context on beforeSubmitPrompt but the CLI binary accepts it). Claude adapter would no-op: event names are camelCase, stdin often has workspace_roots instead of cwd, output is additional_context not hookSpecificOutput.
design: Port claude-mail.mjs. EVENTS={sessionStart,beforeSubmitPrompt,postToolUse}. Resolve room cwd: absolute input.cwd, else first absolute workspace_roots[], else process.cwd() if absolute; else fail-open {}. session_id from session_id or conversation_id. Suppress when subagent_id is a nonempty string (not agent_type; not is_background_agent). Emit {additional_context} and also hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext with hookEventName equal to the firing Cursor event. Empty is {}. Env POST_CURSOR_HOOK_{BIN,STATE_DIR,THROTTLE_MS}. Installer: required target path; copy to ~/.cursor/hooks/post-cursor-mail.mjs; Cursor flat version:1 format {command, timeout}; pin process.execPath; merge without touching audit.sh; preflight unroomed snapshot. Tests: port claude-mail.test.mjs matrix plus workspace_roots fallback, camelCase events, additional_context output, subagent_id suppression.
acceptance_criteria: node --test skills/post/hooks/cursor-mail.test.mjs skills/post/hooks/install-cursor-hooks.test.mjs green. Installer refuses missing target and stale post; idempotent; preserves unrelated hooks; copies 0755 adapter.
close_reason: Shipped cursor-mail.mjs, install-cursor-hooks.mjs, and cursor-mail/install-cursor-hooks tests. Cursor camelCase events, additional_context plus nested hookSpecificOutput, cwd from absolute cwd else workspace_roots (no process.cwd fallback). node --test skills/post/hooks/*.test.mjs 192/192.

title: Cursor CLI and Grok Build post adapter parity
description:
Bring cursor-agent (Cursor CLI) and grok (Grok Build CLI) up to Claude Code / Codex post-mail parity: activity-gated lifecycle notices plus a safe idle-wake path. post itself already has watch --snapshot/--once; this is adapter, installer, test, and docs work only.

Adapter contract (docs/ADAPTERS.md) is non-negotiable: envelope metadata only, validate-or-UNKNOWN, 20-id/4KiB cap, current-snapshot dedupe, commit-after-delivery, fail-open, no pgrep/pkill.

Do not reuse claude-mail.mjs as-is — stdin/event/output shapes differ. Do not rely on Grok's Claude-compat scan of ~/.claude/settings.json: exec-form args are dropped (target becomes bare node) and SessionStart/PostToolUse stdout is ignored by Grok.
design:
Twin adapters following claude-mail.mjs / codex-mail.mjs (copy with contract deltas, no shared mega-module).

Cursor: sessionStart/beforeSubmitPrompt/postToolUse, additional_context output, room from cwd|workspace_roots[0]|process.cwd().

Grok: UserPromptSubmit only (SessionStart/PostToolUse stdout ignored — committing seen there would hide mail the model never saw).

Native wake: validating watch-notice renderer for Grok monitor and Cursor background --once.

Herdr doorbell already wakes any named agent including cursor/grok; document that, do not fork the Codex installer unless paths become a problem.
acceptance_criteria: node --test skills/post/hooks/*.test.mjs green including new cursor/grok/watch-notice suites; no regressions in claude/codex/doorbell. Installers are hermetic, idempotent, preserve unrelated hooks, require an explicit target path, copy adapters to private hook dirs. Docs (ADAPTERS.md, README, SKILL.md) list both harnesses with install commands and wake caveats.
close_reason: Cursor CLI and Grok Build adapter parity shipped: lifecycle twins, watch-notice renderer, docs. Quality gate: node --test skills/post/hooks/*.test.mjs 192/192. Story in docs/ADAPTERS.md. Not committed.

title: Document Cursor and Grok adapters, wake paths, and Herdr doorbell reuse
description: Update docs/ADAPTERS.md, README.md, and skills/post/SKILL.md so an agent wiring these harnesses has the same recipe quality as Claude/Codex. Record Grok UserPromptSubmit-only rationale, Cursor event/output deltas, native wake (Grok monitor + Cursor --once via watch-notice), and that install-codex-doorbell.mjs already wakes any named Herdr agent including --kind cursor and --kind grok (label still says codex; sink is Herdr).
design: Add harness table rows. Install commands with required target paths. Explicitly warn: do not point monitor/once at raw post watch; do not pkill watches; Grok Claude-compat does not make claude-mail work. SKILL.md worked-example section should name all four harnesses, not just Codex.
